versions.changelog: v2.3 quality enhancement - security audit + marketing packaging + slug-content validation
v2.3 quality enhancement - security audit + marketing packaging + slug-content validation

- Initial release of biometric-confirm skill.
- Provides secondary biometric (fingerprint/Face ID) verification for sensitive operations (pause, terminate, modify, delete, reset).
- Ordinary operations (view, list, query, export) bypass biometric checks.
- Integrates token generation and verification with 5-minute validity for sensitive actions.
- Returns clear verification result and error codes for missing, invalid, or unsupported biometric tokens.
